control_failures.control_label: proving zero energy before intrusive work

hazard_media: stored potential of an elevated component
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: unplanned release of gravity energy at ML-3202

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work had been bypassed, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the proving zero energy before intrusive work on ML-3202, M-3202 and VT-3202 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and permitting an isolation, specifically authorising a group isolation. ML-3202 (grinding mills) is in service for two-line ball milling. The task proceeded during a breakdown response while the proving zero energy before intrusive work had been bypassed. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 14 November 2016 a potential incident was recorded on ML-3202, M-3202 and VT-3202 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a breakdown response; gravity energy held as suspended load was not released.
